quantization.rounding: FP32 division then nearest halfway-away-from-zero then clip
quantization.weights: original GGUF to_float row then fixed per-row quantization shared cache
quantization.activation: whole original vector quantized once per GEMV; partials slice the same bytes
quantization.output: I64 integer sum; convert once to F32; multiply once by FP32(rowScale*inputScale)
